## Description {#details}

<p>A <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/namespaces/llvm/#a8e612822d4ba7bb36c9c79582a567108">BumpPtrAllocator</a> that allows only elements of a specific type to be allocated.</p>


<p>This allows calling the destructor in <a href="#a9f4abb0f59d9fd2ce9dfe8ceebffcb38">DestroyAll()</a> and when the allocator is destroyed.</p>


<p>Definition at line 389 of file <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/include/include/llvm/include/llvm/support/allocator-h">Allocator.h</a>.</p>
